backgrounds.name: Charlatan
backgrounds.feature: False Identity: You have an alternate persona backed by papers, contacts, and disguises. You can counterfeit documents or handwriting after studying a suitable example.

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.feature: Criminal Contact: A dependable underworld contact connects you with other criminals. You know intermediaries who can carry messages between you and that contact over long distances.

backgrounds.name: Entertainer
backgrounds.feature: By Popular Demand: You can find a venue that provides meals and lodging at a modest or comfortable standard in exchange for nightly performances. People who recognize your act in a settlement generally respond favorably to you.
equipment: One musical instrument of your choice

backgrounds.name: Folk Hero
backgrounds.feature: Rustic Hospitality: Commoners will offer shelter, a place to recover, and help evading pursuers unless you have endangered them. Their help stops short of putting their own lives at risk.
equipment: One set of artisan's tools of your choice

backgrounds.name: Guild Artisan
backgrounds.feature: Guild Membership: Your guild can supply food, lodging, funeral costs, professional contacts, and support against defensible criminal accusations; political introductions may require a contribution. Membership costs 5 gp each month, and overdue dues must be paid before benefits resume.
equipment: One set of artisan's tools of your choice

backgrounds.name: Hermit
backgrounds.feature: Discovery: You possess an exceptional discovery from your time in isolation. Decide with the DM what you learned and how it affects the campaign.

backgrounds.name: Noble
backgrounds.feature: Position of Privilege: Your title gains you acceptance in high society, deference from commoners, and recognition as a peer by other nobles. You can obtain a meeting with a local noble when needed.

backgrounds.name: Outlander
backgrounds.feature: Wanderer: You remember maps and the broad layout of places you have seen. Where natural supplies are available, you can gather enough food and fresh water each day for yourself and five others.

backgrounds.name: Sage
backgrounds.feature: Researcher: When a fact escapes you, you often know a person or collection that could supply it. The DM decides whether that source is reachable or the information can be found at all.

backgrounds.name: Sailor
backgrounds.feature: Ship's Passage: Friendly sailing contacts can arrange free sea travel for you and your companions in return for helping the crew. The ship's route and departure may differ from your plans, and the DM sets the journey's duration.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.feature: Military Rank: Members of your former military organization recognize your rank, and lower-ranking loyal soldiers defer to you. Where that rank is honored, you can influence soldiers, borrow basic supplies or horses, and usually enter friendly military sites.
equipment: Dice Set or Playing Card Set

backgrounds.name: Urchin
backgrounds.feature: City Secrets: You can navigate overlooked shortcuts through a city. Outside combat, you and companions you guide can travel between city locations in half the usual time.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.desc: Natural cover that only lightly obscures you is enough to attempt a Stealth check to hide; success follows the normal hiding rules.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: Direct sunlight imposes disadvantage on your attacks and visual Perception checks if it illuminates either you or the relevant creature or object.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.desc: Innate magic (CHA): dancing lights; from level 3, cast faerie fire once per long rest, and from level 5, cast darkness once per long rest.

traits.name: Drow Weapon Training
traits.desc: Weapon proficiencies: rapier, shortsword, hand crossbow.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.desc: Poison defense: saves against poison have advantage, and poison damage is halved by resistance.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.desc: Innate cantrip: minor illusion, cast with INT.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.desc: Exchange basic messages with beasts no larger than Small, using gestures and noises.
